title: trendradar releases v2
description: Repo release subscription documents. ReleaseDigest is the rendered on-disk document; ReleasesReport is the per-run diagnostic carried in RunResult.releases. Token cost lives in ReleasesReport.usage (always present), never in ReleaseDigest, because cost is a property of one run and cannot be reproduced from a stored document. schema=2 originally put one weekly summary per repo (repos[].summaryZh); schema 2 cores now write a per-version summary on each repos[].releases[].summaryZh instead, and leave repos[].summaryZh empty on new data. Both fields stay optional (readable old + new documents): consumers should prefer the per-item summaryZh and fall back to the repo-level one for older documents.

ReleaseItem.description: One release or tag. kind distinguishes a GitHub release (has notes) from a tag fallback (commit message used as the summary basis). summaryZh is this version's own Chinese summary, written per version by current cores (incremental). It stays optional so old documents (which only carry the repo-level RepoReleases.summaryZh) remain valid; consumers should prefer this field and fall back to RepoReleases.summaryZh.

id.description: GitHub release id; 0 when the item comes from a tag fallback.

bodyExcerpt.description: Truncated raw release notes. Untrusted text: display only, never execute.

summaryZh.description: Legacy per-item summary. Still accepted so documents written before schema 2 stay readable; schema 2 writers leave it empty.

RepoReleases.description: One repo's release batch for one summary period. periodStart/periodEnd bound the period (attributed to the versions' publish dates) so a consumer can label it without parsing dates. summaryZh (repo-level, whole-week) is kept for backward compatibility: current cores summarize per version (releases[].summaryZh) and leave this empty on new data.

summaryZh.description: Legacy: one Chinese summary for the whole period. Current cores leave this empty and put a per-version summary in releases[].summaryZh. Kept optional for older documents.

ReleasesReport.description: Per-run diagnostic for the releases stage. usage, checked and changed are required and always serialized so a consumer can tell 'nothing spent / checked / changed' (0) from 'not reported' (missing). checked counts repos the stage examined; changed counts repos that produced a document write.

ReleaseManifestEntry.description: One row of GET /api/v2/releases. Cost is intentionally absent: manifests describe stored documents, which carry no run cost.

SubscriptionStatus.description: Per-repo check state of the most recent weekly release run: baseline (first sighting, no section written), ok (a week section was written), no_change (checked, nothing new), rate_limited / failed (check failed, cursor kept so the next run retries).

SubscriptionItem.description: One row of the subscriptions table. Deliberately small: the full markdown lives behind SubscriptionDoc so the list stays under the first-paint payload budget.

latestSummaryAt.description: Date of the newest week section (its period end), used as the 'last summary' column.

SubscriptionList.description: Response of GET /api/v2/subscriptions and of the IPC subscribe list command. repos stays the only field old consumers read; items is the additive per-repo detail.

SubscriptionVolume.description: One volume file of a repo's release document. Every volume is numbered: index N is <repo>-0N.md (zero padded), so the first volume is -01. from/to are the oldest/newest week bounds present in that file.

file.description: Path relative to the releases document root (e.g. vercel/next.js-01.md).

SubscriptionDoc.description: Response of the IPC subscribe releases command and of GET /api/v2/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases. markdown is the exact file content: the panel renders it verbatim (single source of truth, no re-summarizing).
